result:
The proposed answer is wrong. A much smaller value is achievable.

Take any spanning tree on the 2025 cities and color all its edges X. The condition only applies when two edges sharing a vertex have different colors, and here no such pair exists, so the condition holds vacuously. The graph is connected, with n_X = 2024 and n_Y = n_Z = 0, so max(n_X, n_Y, n_Z) = 2024.

Since 455625 > 2024, the claimed minimum is not minimal. The proposed solution also never justifies its restriction to complete tripartite graphs with all three colors used, so nothing supports its optimality claim.

VERDICT: REJECT
CONFIDENCE: 5
